basicInfo.name: Yoongun
basicInfo.flavor: Rather than live in cowardice and turn a blind eye to the suffering of the people, Yoongun resolved he would sooner die with his head held high and his integrity intact, facing the heavens without shame.

Normal Attack.desc:
Single Enemy
 - Deals damage equal to 145% of Magic Attack 1 time(s).
 - 100% chance to inflict Buff Duration Reduction. [Reduced by: 1 Turn(s)]
Skill Enhancement Effect
 - Increases Damage: To 145% of Physical Attack.

Skill 1.desc:
4 Enemies
 - Deals damage equal to 50% of Magic Attack 3 time(s).
 - 100% chance to inflict 2 Buff Removal(s).
Skill Enhancement Effect
 - Increases Damage: To 50% of Physical Attack.
Transcend Lv.2 Effect
 - Adds Effect: Ignores 40% of Defense.
Transcend Lv.6 Effect
 - Adds Effect: Activates [Rapid Volley] again up to 1 time(s) with 70% power upon defeating an enemy with this skill.

Skill 2.desc:
All Enemies
 - 40% chance to inflict Binding Rope when the target's current HP is 50% or higher. [Duration: 2 Turn(s)]
 - Inflicts 39% HP Alteration
 - Deals Piercing damage equal to 58% of Magic Attack 3 time(s). (Damage increases by up to 50% proportional to the target's current HP)
Skill Enhancement Effect
 - Increases Damage: To 58% of Physical Attack.
Transcend Lv.2 Effect
 - Adds Effect: Ignores 40% of Defense.
Transcend Lv.6 Effect
 - Adds Effect: Consecutively activates [Tenfold Barrage] up to 1 time(s) with 70% power upon defeating an enemy with this skill.

Passive.desc:
Self
 - Grants Blessing. [Always Active]
 - Grants Crit Rate Boost. [Always Active]
 - Grants Weakness Hit Chance Boost. [Always Active]
 - Grants a Barrier equal to 185% of the caster's Magic Attack. [Duration: 3 Turn(s)]
 - * Grants the following effects if deployed to a team with 3 or more Magic heroes.
 - Increases All Damage Nullification's hit count by 1 hit(s) upon using a basic attack 1 time(s). [Max 6 Hit(s)]
 - Increases All Damage Nullification's hit count by 2 hit(s) upon activating a skill 1 time(s). [Max 6 Hit(s)]
 - Grants All Debuff Removal upon being inflicted with Crowd Control. [1 Time(s) per Battle]
 - Grants Crowd Control Immunity when a debuff is removed. [Duration: 2 Turn(s)]
 - 3 Enemies
 - Deals Piercing damage equal to 75% of Magic Attack plus 22% of the target's Max HP 1 time(s) upon using any attack 2 time(s). (HP-based damage limited to 300% of caster's Attack)
Skill Enhancement Effect
 - Increases Effect: Crit Rate Boost to 50%.
 - Increases Effect: Weakness Hit Chance Boost to 50%.
 - Increases Effect: Barrier absorption becomes equal to 185% of Physical Attack.

Awaken Skill.name: All-Out Fire
Awaken Skill.desc:
All Enemies
 - 50% chance to inflict Binding Rope. [Duration: 2 Turn(s)]
 - Deals damage equal to 80% of Magic Attack 2 time(s).
 - Deals Defense-Ignoring damage equal to 80% of Magic Attack 2 time(s).
Skill Enhancement Effect
 - Adds Effect: Ignores 65% of Defense.

basicInfo.name: Yoongun
basicInfo.flavor: By day, Yoongun trained with his sword. By night, he would read his books, reciting the words so loudly the sound even carried to the neighboring village. Viewing him as an eccentric, the people kept their distance. But he often lent a helping hand, repairing farm tools or gathering medicinal herbs for the sick, and the people gradually came to trust and follow him.
